sources.excerpt: WARLOW mini WARLOW mini $158.00 Sale price $158.00 Regular price Decrease quantity Increase quantity Add to cart Our classic WARLOW now in a smaller enclosure. Looking for a pedal that captures the raw, wild sound of the Seattle music scene? Look no further than the JPTR FX WARLOW - a premium-quality OP Amp "Big Muff" pedal that has been painstakingly rebuilt to deliver an even bigger, wider sound with more gain and volume. What sets the WARLOW apart from other "Big Muff" inspired pedals is its unique filter section, which combines both classic and "Proco Rat" filters for a truly versatile and dynamic sound. Whether you're playing gritty grunge riffs or soaring solos, the WARLOW can deliver the tone you need to stand out from the crowd. But what really makes the WARLOW special is its backstory. This pedal was rebuilt using a vintage "Big Muff" from the same release date as the Siamese Dream album, which means it has a rich history and character that you won't find in other pedals. And with its incredible sound and build quality, the WARLOW is sure to become a staple in your rig for years to come. If you're ready to take your playing to the next level and capture the raw power of the Seattle sound, order your JPTR FX WARLOW today and experience the ultimate in pedal performance.
